title: Representation Learning via Composite Subspace Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.32256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distilling semantic meaning from raw image data remains a challenge in machine learning. Current self-supervised paradigms face a trade-off: joint-embedding architectures produce relevant features by aggressively discarding intra-class variance, irreversibly spatial and reconstruction. Conversely, generative models preserve spatial details but struggle to isolate semantics, as their optimization is dominated by pixel variations. To bridge this divide, we propose composite subspace flow matching (CSFM). Rather than corrupting data with unstructured isotropic noise, CSFM formulates representation learning as the variance-minimizing inversion of a deterministic degradation curriculum across spectral, color, and illumination subspaces. By bounding trajectory variance with hard temporal style truncation, a capacity-constrained encoder is driven to ignore transient style artifacts and encode persistent content. translated_title: 基于复合子空间流匹配的表示学习
translated_abstract: 从原始图像数据中提取语义信息仍然是机器学习领域的一个挑战。当前的自监督学习范式面临权衡：联合嵌入架构通过激进地丢弃类内方差来产生相关特征，不可逆地损失了空间与重建信息；相反，生成模型保留了空间细节，却难以分离语义，因为其优化过程被像素变化所主导。为了弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了复合子空间流匹配（CSFM）。CSFM 并非使用非结构化的各向同性噪声来破坏数据，而是将表示学习表述为跨光谱、颜色和光照子空间进行的确定性退化课程的方差最小化求逆。通过硬性时间风格截断来约束轨迹方差，容量受限的编码器被驱动去忽略瞬态的风格伪影，并编码持久的内容信息。在……（原文此处被截断）上的实证评估……
tldr: 提出复合子空间流匹配（CSFM），通过在光谱、颜色和光照子空间上对确定性退化课程进行方差最小化求逆，并以硬性时间风格截断约束轨迹方差，使编码器忽略瞬态风格、编码持久内容，从而弥合了联合嵌入与生成式自监督范式之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: We propose Composite Subspace Flow Matching (CSFM), which formulates representation learning as variance-minimizing inversion of a deterministic degradation curriculum across spectral, color, and illumination subspaces, using hard temporal style truncation to drive a capacity-constrained encoder to ignore transient style artifacts and encode persistent content, thereby bridging the trade-off between joint-embedding and generative self-supervised paradigms.
